notes: VoltSpace tariff data is kept separate from the calculation code so that a tariff
revision only requires editing this JSON file.
Tier prices and the summer window follow Taiwan Power Company (Taipower) published
residential (non-business, metered-light) rates that have applied since 2024-04-01.
The 2025 electricity price review committee decided to freeze residential rates.
IMPORTANT: every price here is an ESTIMATE input, not a guarantee of the amount a
user will be billed. Landlords of rented rooms often resell electricity at a flat
rate (see flat_rate_resell_reference), so a real bill may differ from these tiers.

tw_residential_tiered.name_zh: 台電住宅用電－累進（級距）電價
tw_residential_tiered.applicable_to: Table-light non-business residential users (表燈非營業用)

tw_residential_tou.name_zh: 台電住宅用電－時間電價（二段式，估算）
tw_residential_tou.applicable_to: Residential users who opted into a two-segment time-of-use contract
tw_residential_tou.source: Taipower residential time-of-use electricity price table
tw_residential_tou.estimate_note: Time-of-use rates vary by contract capacity, season and peak/off-peak window; this simplified table is for education and comparison only.

flat_rate_resell_reference.name_zh: 單一費率參考（租屋常見房東轉售價）
flat_rate_resell_reference.applicable_to: Rented rooms where the landlord resells electricity at a flat per-kWh price
flat_rate_resell_reference.source: Common market practice for NTHU off-campus rented rooms
